description: This file defines the Numbers_Words class which provides methods to convert Arabic numerals to words, including currency representations, and handles external language files and PEAR error handling.

classes.name: Numbers_Words
classes.description: A class providing methods to convert numbers to words and currency words, with error handling via PEAR.

methods.name: toWords
methods.description: Converts a number to its word representation in a specified locale.

methods.name: toCurrency
methods.description: Converts a currency value to its word representation, handling fractional parts.

methods.name: raiseError
methods.description: Triggers a PEAR error with a given message.
